## Complete Bibliography

The references below cover all sources cited or recommended across the chapters of this course. They are organized by thematic area corresponding to the course structure.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Language, Machines, and Theoretical Foundations

-   **Chomsky, N.** (1957). *Syntactic Structures*. Mouton.
-   **Jurafsky, D., & Martin, J. H.** (2025). *Speech and Language Processing* (3rd ed. draft). Stanford University. https://web.stanford.edu/\~jurafsky/slp3/
-   **Manning, C. D., & Schütze, H.** (1999). *Foundations of Statistical Natural Language Processing*. MIT Press.
-   **Russell, S., & Norvig, P.** (2010). *Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach* (3rd ed.). Prentice Hall.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Basic Data Engineering and Preprocessing

-   **Bird, S., Klein, E., & Loper, E.** (2009). *Natural Language Processing with Python*. O'Reilly Media. https://www.nltk.org/book/
-   **Bostrom, K., & Durrett, G.** (2020). Byte Pair Encoding is Suboptimal for Language Model Pretraining. *Findings of EMNLP*.
-   **Sennrich, R., Haddow, B., & Birch, A.** (2016). Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units. *ACL*.
